title: SweetChat
description: A simple chat plugin with custom format and local (nearby) mode.
body:
# SweetChat
A Minecraft chat formatting plugin.

> Default configurations are in Chinese. Check [localization](https://github.com/mcio-dev/localization) repository for English or other language.  
> And I am sorry about that the wiki is only Chinese available right now. In the future, we may translate it to English.

## Introduction
A simple yet powerful chat formatting plugin that supports cross-server communication. Define different formats for local and cross-server messages!
+ **Cross-Server Support:** Broadcast messages via BC (BungeeCord) message channels or database polling.
+ **Nearby Chat:** Support for proximity-based chat (visible within X blocks) and "shout" functionality.
+ **Chat Features:** Placeholder replacement for features like "Show Item in Hand" and "Custom Variables."
+ **Message Styles:** Assign different styles to players based on permissions to enable default message colors.

## Plugin Conflicts
+ Please go to the [CMI](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/3742/) configuration file `Chat.yml` and disable all options under `ModifyChatFormat` to prevent chat formats from being overwritten.

## Commands
Root command `/sweetchat`, aliases: `/chat`, `/schat`, or `/sc`.  
Parameters wrapped in `<>` are required, while `[]` are optional.

| Command | Description | Permission |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/chat mode <mode/clear> [player]` | Set a player's default chat mode | `sweet.chat.mode` |
| `/chat sudo <player> <message>` | Force an online player to send a chat message | OP/Console |
| `/chat reload database` | Reconnect to the database | OP/Console |
| `/chat reload` | Reload configuration files | OP/Console |

## Permissions
+ `sweetchat.style.KeyName` - Allows using a specific style defined in `styles.yml`.
+ `sweetchat.local.bypass` - Allows viewing all local chat (nearby chat) on the current sub-server, even if the speaker is not nearby.

For more permissions, please refer to the documentation on [MCIO Plugins](https://plugins.mcio.dev/docs/chat/commands).
